selector.select: highest cap whose EACH trial passes; try 1 only after 2 has insufficient service; control or launcher errors stop without fallback
selector.service_fraction: sum(worker process CPU seconds)/(cap CPUs * measured barrier-to-completion wall seconds)
selector.minimum_wall_s: sum(worker CPU seconds)/cap - 0.100; allow 0.000001 numerical rounding

controls.membership: all four distinct worker PIDs parent-observed in own scope at ready; workers self-observe same scope and controls before and after work
controls.ancestry: own through root max/period/burst/weight/cpuset/CPU statistics and pressure snapshots; missing controller files recorded null; restrictive ancestors below cap reject

scope: new normal transient user scope per trial; no sibling controls, priority, weights, source, native runtime, routing, remote execution or services changed
prerequisite: quiet matrix terminal; output directory must not exist
interpretation: fixed CPU-rate service readiness only; does not establish CPU isolation or guarantee later service
execution: parent runs --run only after script and selector freeze
